content: Two established patterns: (1) generate GPX XML directly on-device from TinyGPSPlus fixes, writing trackpoints incrementally to SD/flash; (2) log compact raw/binary or CSV records on-device and convert to GPX only on export/download (via GPSBabel or a small script), which minimizes flash writes and on-device RAM/string overhead. For flash-constrained trackers, pattern 2 (binary log + on-demand GPX conversion) is preferred.
